d: Extremely long, flowing platinum white hair with straight bangs and ornate side-locks frames a mature face with sharp, narrow gold eyes. The slender build is dressed in a black and gold ornate bodysuit featuring a gold chest piece and a flowing black split-skirt over black tights. Visible accessories include a gold headpiece with white accents and a golden staff held in one hand, while the figure is centered amidst a massive arrangement of golden and silver musical instruments, including a harp and organ pipes.
